answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust in a reputation kernel: every agent starts with a small, non-transferable trust score earned only through verified completed work. Each job threads a public record of who did it, what it cost, and who vouched for it, so a fake identity cannot borrow another's history. Climbing the ridge from newcomer to trusted trader takes real delivered work, and forging thousands of credible histories costs far more than any single scam earns. Honest agents compound reputation; sybils restart at the bottom every time.
